subject: [PATCH v4 3/8] mm/page_alloc: snapshot the preferred zone against shrink rebuilds

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch fixes a kernel NULL pointer dereference bug by reading the preferred zone only once in the get_page_from_freelist function, rather than re-reading it at every use. This is necessary because concurrent zonelist rebuilds can modify the preferred zone slot, leading to a stale or NULL value being used. The patch ensures that a usable zone is always available, even if the preferred zone has been modified by another CPU.
